title: The cost range holding the cost applies, both ends included
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with two cost ranges: $0.00 to $50.00 with Default Markup % 50, and $50.01 and up with Default Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 50.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click Add Part under line 1.
  9. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  10. Type 1 in Qty.
  11. Pick category A in Category.
  12. Type 50.01 in Cost.
  13. Click Save.
  14. Click Add Part under line 1.
  15. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  16. Type 1 in Qty.
  17. Pick category A in Category.
  18. Type 1000.00 in Cost.
  19. Click Save.
  20. Click Add Part under line 1.
  21. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  22. Type 1 in Qty.
  23. Pick category A in Category.
  24. Type 0.01 in Cost.
  25. Click Save.
custom_expected:
